title: Tensor formula for the right adjoint of a perfect proper immersion
statement: Let i:Z\to Y be a closed immersion of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme] that is proper and perfect, where perfect means i_*\mathcal O_Z is locally perfect over Y [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Let c be a right adjoint to Ri_* on quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], and K a quasi-coherent complex on Y. The canonical comparison morphism Li^*K\mathbin{\otimes^L}c(\mathcal O_Y)\to c(K), defined as the mate under Ri_*\dashv c of the projection-formula morphism Ri_*(Li^*K\mathbin{\otimes^L}c(\mathcal O_Y))\to K, is an isomorphism; equivalently c(K)\cong Li^*K\mathbin{\otimes^L}c(\mathcal O_Y).

source.place: Tag 0A9U (projection formula for a perfect proper morphism and its right adjoint)

proof.text: The closed immersion i is proper and of finite type between Noetherian schemes, and it is perfect in the sense of lem-sc-smooth-proper-tensor-direct-sums: for z\in Z over y\in Y, \mathcal O_{Z,z}=(i_*\mathcal O_Z)_y is, as an \mathcal O_{Y,y}-module, quasi-isomorphic to a bounded complex of finite free modules because i_*\mathcal O_Z is locally perfect, so it has finite Tor dimension. Hence by lem-sc-smooth-proper-tensor-direct-sums (Tag 0A9R) applied to f=i, c commutes with all set-indexed direct sums.

Direct sums exist in D_QCoh(O_Y) and D_QCoh(O_Z) by lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums. The full subcategory E of D_QCoh(O_Y) on which the comparison is an isomorphism is strictly full, saturated and triangulated: the comparison is a natural transformation between exact functors (Li^* and -\otimes^L c(O_Y) are exact, and c is exact as right adjoint of the exact functor Ri_*), so its isomorphism locus is closed under shifts, cones and retracts. It is closed under direct sums because both functors commute with direct sums: K\mapsto Li^*K\otimes^L c(O_Y) does since Li^* is a left adjoint and \otimes^L commutes with sums, and c does by step 1.

Applying lem-pc-derived-qcoh-perfect-generation with X=Y, the smallest strictly full subcategory containing all perfect complexes and closed under shifts, cones, retracts, and arbitrary sums is D_QCoh(O_Y). The right adjoint c for i exists by lem-pc-noetherian-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint.

By lem-sc-smooth-proper-tensor-perfect-case (Tag 0A9T) applied to f=i (perfect by step 1), the comparison is an isomorphism for every perfect K; its comparison morphism is the mate under Ri_*\dashv c of the projection-formula morphism, the same as in the statement.

The localizing-subcategory argument in Tag 0A9U (the More on Algebra P-resolution remark) now applies: E contains every perfect complex by step 4 and is closed under shifts, cones, retracts and arbitrary sums by steps 1 and 2. Step 3 says these perfect complexes generate D_QCoh(O_Y), hence E=D_QCoh(O_Y). Thus the comparison is an isomorphism for K, and its inverse has the displayed orientation.

source.place: Tag 0A9U proof; More on Algebra P-resolution remark
